stem: Valemont's division manager controls pricing and costs but has no authority over the level of assets invested in the division. What type of responsibility center is most appropriate for evaluation?

choices.A: A cost center, evaluated only on cost variances
choices.B: A profit center, evaluated on operating income rather than ROI or residual income
choices.C: A revenue center, evaluated only on sales dollars
choices.D: An investment center, evaluated on ROI

swap_analysis.before_ew_a_described: Choice D (investment center): 'An investment center requires authority over asset investment levels...'
swap_analysis.before_ew_d_described: Choice A (cost center): 'A cost center evaluates only cost performance and ignores the manager's pricing authority...'
swap_analysis.after_ew_a_describes: Choice A (cost center): correct after swap
swap_analysis.after_ew_d_describes: Choice D (investment center): correct after swap

remediation.method: 3-step swap (temp marker) to avoid ambiguous matches with P1-CD-023's similar text
remediation.ew_a_before: An investment center requires authority over asset investment levels. Since this manager lacks control over invested assets, ROI evaluation is not appropriate. A profit center using operating income better matches the manager's span of control.
remediation.ew_a_after: A cost center evaluates only cost performance and ignores the manager's pricing authority. Since this manager controls both pricing decisions and costs, a profit center based on operating income better captures the full scope of responsibility.
remediation.ew_d_before: A cost center evaluates only cost performance and ignores the manager's pricing authority. Since this manager controls both pricing decisions and costs, a profit center based on operating income better captures the full scope of responsibility.
remediation.ew_d_after: An investment center requires authority over asset investment levels. Since this manager lacks control over invested assets, ROI evaluation is not appropriate. A profit center using operating income better matches the manager's span of control.
remediation.reason: Both texts are self-contained and do not reference specific choice letters or 'Option X' lead-ins — a pure swap is sufficient.
